title: Rescaling the radius in a scaled Lebesgue-point limit
statement: Let n be a natural number, L : R -> [0, infinity] any function and rho > 0. Suppose ENNReal.ofReal((t^n)^{-1}) * L(t) -> 0 in [0, infinity] as t -> 0+ (along nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)). Then (a) L(r rho) != infinity for all r eventually along nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0), and (b) (r^n)^{-1} * (L(r rho)).toReal -> 0 in R as r -> 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((t ^ n)⁻¹) * L t) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), L (r * ρ) ≠ ⊤) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (L (r * ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
